analyst.summary: IREDA is India's leading government-backed lender to renewable-energy projects, riding a genuine multi-year tailwind as the country builds out solar, wind and green-hydrogen capacity. But recent quarters have shown softer, more volatile profits, margin compression, and -- most notably -- a July 2026 disclosure that over Rs.672 crore of exposure (to Gensol Engineering and its leasing subsidiary) has been classified as fraudulent. We rate it a Hold, but flag this asset-quality deterioration as a genuine point of concern rather than routine noise.
